AMMONIACUM.

Crum  ammoniac.      Umhelliferce.


A  Persian  gum  obtained  from  Dorema  ammoniacum,  an  umbelliferous
plant.  A  drug  famous  since  ancient  times.  Proved  and  introduced  by  I.
G.  Jahnel  in  1837,  proved  again  by  J.  B.  Buchner  in  1840,  and  by  several
others  in  1847.
